purpose: Construct a new conditional phase law that removes the tiny-CDF-probability divisor from the P derivative; measure the resulting distributional and waveform tradeoff, without claiming an equivalent decoder optimization.
definition: Q_new(P,u)=(1-w)*Q_i(u)+w*Q_(i+1)(u), with the original conditional rows, original P knots, original shared phase branch and original clamping. Q_i is the exact row inverse including atoms. At a knot it equals the old decoder. Between knots it generally does not preserve the old conditional CDF or circular moments.
